about: The mods testq's filler walks, in fill order (coverage.py; TESTQ_MODS_WIRE_BEYOND_FLOWWORKS). The tick walks this order rotated to start after the newest filler job's mod (coverage.fill_order), so each wire gets its turn. Wire the next one from `coverage.py rank` (selectable mods by open bridge items naming them); `coverage.py check` fails if any wired mod's probe stops reading selectable. TESTQ_FILL_MODS, when set, overrides this file.
